overview: Shiva(Manoj Nandan) is a normal middle class guy who dreams of becoming an actor. He tries hard but does not get any break. Seeing his pathetic situation, Shiva’s friend Madan(Anil Kalyan) decides to rent out his ancestral property. To his good luck a movie unit comes forward to shoot their film in the estate.
title: Chitram Bhalare Vichitram
